scope: Same-frame physical-contact continuation capability and independent automatic-voice ordering prerequisites
capability_cases: Preparation before accepted parent commit or after a miss returns no continuation.
Alternative plans share one publication right; discarding or rejecting a stale plan does not spend it.
Already selected reactions, blocked dispatch, disarm and Counter phase 1 do not grant another consequence phase.
Resource debits, wear, knockback and ordinary-hit input cannot replay in a continuation.
Requery current actor values/process state after synchronous callbacks; stale plans reject without publication.
A compiled scripted Say INFO result ModAV Health -2 between original Health -3 and continuation retains total Health -5.
World continuation publishes a BlockHit with the consumed original cause and stages its own RNG transition.
Terminal death continuation does not add a second death event or repeat resource damage.
Frame advancement, even zero duration, expires continuation rights despite retained service copies; restore/clear invalidate prior service rights.
